text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: In 1st place is Hishi Akebono--!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was huge! I mean, running 
alongside her has some seriously insane 
presence, right!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Look! I got such a super cool and 
impactful photo! Sorry for saying I wanted 
to take funny ones...!

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Buono-chan is usually so soft and gentle, 
but in races, she looks so sharp, 
imposing, and cool~

text_block_list.name: Bono's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Man, seriously, maybe I should go watch 
the next race too! It's kind of getting 
addictive!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Yay, yay~! I won, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everyone went all out with everything they 
had, it was so much fun! I was so happy to 
see the audience having a blast too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It was such a dreamlike sight! And I'm so, 
so full...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, like, I seriously can't wait for the 
next one~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"For the next race, I hope it's just as 
good as today... no, even fuller, waaaay 
fuller than today~☆"

With her body in peak condition, she 
proved she could compete splendidly even 
in short-distance GⅠ races.

"Then next... I want to aim for a GⅠ 
victory in a mile race!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hah! That's... a really big mile race, 
isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I just know tons of super strong girls 
are gonna gather! Like Biko-chan, again!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Yeah, yeah, I want to aim for that! 
Let's go with that, Trainer!

Still, jumping straight from sprints to 
aiming for a Mile GⅠ is a bit concerning.

For now, I'd like to run a major race 
around 1400m.
choice_data_list:
Let's fit in the Swan Stakes once along 
the way, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds good~. A swan, huh~. Big 
birds are so nice.

At any rate, our next target race was set. 
Just as we got our spirits fired up again—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Biko-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*. Bono was amazing~.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was so amazed by Bono's running. 
Their eyes were sparkling...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, I... I...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I can't get down in the dumps! You 
can't be a hero if you're moping around!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Stand up, Biko Pegasus! Don't give up, 
Biko Pegasus!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOH!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Biko-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...What you just saw is our little secret, 
okay, Trainer?

Meanwhile, in the sparsely populated 
stands, Taiki Shuttle stood alone, 
trembling with excitement...

—There was once an American-born 
Umamusume, full of power and bright 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Exciting!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Big and powerful, super exciting! Hishi 
Akebono is a wonderful girl!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I... I really want to run in a big race 
with her!

...Amid a swirl of mixed emotions, the 
Sprinters Stakes came to an end.

Next is the Swan Stakes. To spread her 
wings and soar, days of devoted training 
began!
